_about: The Basic Actions (Core Rules, Chapter 6). One source per card: book/cards/README.md says what each field means. The book renders a card where its chapter writes @@CARD:Name@@; Foundry builds module/basic-data.mjs from it (node tools/gen-basic.mjs); the ruler reads it (spec.mjs).

cards.name: Advance
cards.flavor: You press forward, one deliberate step at a time.

versions.effects: You move up to your Speed in squares, in one piece: the movement you don't use is lost (you can't move part of it, use another Action and move the rest later). Once during this Advance, at any point of the movement, you can use the Interact Action (paying its 1 AP then) and go on moving.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavor: You close the distance in one straight, reckless line.

versions.effects: Advance in a [[Straight Line|straight line]] toward the target, at least 3 squares and up to your Speed, and stop on the first square from which the target is within your Reach. You can't Charge through Difficult Terrain (an unwilling creature's space is Difficult Terrain), even if you have movement left: the Charge ends in the last **empty** square where the line is legal. At the end of your movement, make a Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the target. That Weapon Attack counts toward At-will Banes.

cards.name: Crawl
cards.flavor: You drag yourself along the ground.

versions.effects: **Requirements:** Your Speed is 5 or higher. You move 3 squares.

cards.name: Evade
cards.flavor: You slip through the fray without giving anyone an opening.

versions.effects: Evade 1: a movement that doesn't trigger reactions, in one piece; you can't Evade into or through Difficult Terrain.
Evade half your Speed (rounded down): a movement that doesn't trigger reactions, in one piece; you can't Evade into or through Difficult Terrain.

cards.name: Fists
cards.flavor: When there is nothing else in your hands, there are always your hands.

cards.name: Haul
cards.flavor: You snag them and drag them in.
cards.vs: Appeal or Body (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: Your Reach is 2 or more. The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours and is at least 2 squares away. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

cards.name: Interact
cards.flavor: You pull the lever, open the door, grab what you need.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: draw an object you carry into a free hand; stow an object you hold (put it away on your person, such as sheathing a sword); swap two objects (stow the one you hold and draw another, in the same Action; stowing and swapping need no free hand); grab objects within Reach, as many as you have free hands; help a Prone creature within Reach stand up; help an Imperiled creature within Reach get to safety; wake an Unconscious creature within Reach; open a door, chest or something similar. This Action is broader than most: it can be used for similar things in the world. You can use it once during an Advance Action without ending the Advance (see [[Advance]]).

cards.name: Lean
cards._note: 2026-11-21 (Lucas, playtest 7; the core rework B12): the Action is Lean, the state stays Leaning; it ends when you leave your square.
cards.flavor: You lean out from cover, just enough to see.

versions.effects: Until the end of your turn, or until you leave your square, you are Leaning: you calculate cover from one of your corners instead of the center of your square, and your own cover against other creatures' Actions is reduced by 1 level. You can stop Leaning at any time on your turn, at no cost.

foundry.append: Click a corner of your square on the map to choose which one you lean toward: your token peeks out a little past it (so you can see around a wall that ends there, and you are more exposed too), unless a wall is in the way. Click it again to go back to the center. @Condition[leaning|eot]

cards.name: Opportunity Attack
cards._note: Pack R-core (Lucas, 2026-11-04, decision sheet item 6): the basic Reaction every creature has; it was a Combat Talent with a Critical that disrupted the triggering Action (out of your turn): that Critical goes to a Talent later.
cards.flavor: You punish anyone who moves carelessly near you.
cards.interrupt: An enemy adjacent to you would leave a square during a Move Action or uses the Stand Action.
cards.text: You can make a Weapon Attack (1A) against the triggering creature, as long as your weapon can target them. An NPC makes its Basic attack instead.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an adjacent enemy moves (not an Evade or a Forced Movement) or stands up (v0.0.335, Lucas: adjacent, not the squares you threaten); the movement is not held (Foundry moves the token first), the Weapon Attack is the card's button.

cards.name: Regrip
cards.flavor: You shift your hands on the grip, and the weapon sits where you want it.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: hold a weapon you hold in one hand with both hands (your other hand must be free); move a weapon from one hand to the other; or swap the weapons in your two hands. Regrip doesn't have the Handle trait: it doesn't need a free hand.

cards.name: Release
cards.flavor: You let it go.

versions.effects: You drop an object in your square, or let go of an object you hold with one hand (a two-handed weapon is then held with one hand).

cards.name: Reload
cards.flavor: You work the mechanism and seat a fresh bolt.
cards.requirements: You or an ally within Reach is wielding an unloaded weapon.

tiers: Your next Reload attempt gains 2 Boons.
You Reload the weapon. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.
You Reload the weapon and its wielder can Evade 1. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.

cards.name: Relocate
cards.flavor: You take them by the arm and put them where you want them.
cards.vs: Body or Instinct (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

cards.name: Shake Off
cards.flavor: You beat out the flames, press on the wound, scrape off what burns.
cards.target: You, or one Lingering creature within your Reach

versions.effects: The target makes a Save against its [[Lingering]], with the better of the Lingering's two Attributes, against DC 13 or the DC the Lingering writes. **Tier 1:** no effect. **Tier 2:** it takes half the Lingering at the end of the current turn (whoever's turn it is), then the Lingering ends. **Tier 3:** the Lingering ends.

cards.name: Shove
cards.flavor: You put your weight behind it and drive them back.
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

cards.name: Stand
cards.flavor: You get your feet back under you.

versions.effects: You stand up: you are no longer Prone.

cards.name: Steel Yourself
cards.flavor: You grit your teeth and find a little more to give.
cards.notes: You can't use this Action while Down (Desperate, Dying or Shattered) or Unconscious.

cards.name: Trip
cards.flavor: A hooked foot, a twist, and they hit the ground.
cards.vs: Body or Instinct (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

cards.name: Weapon Attack
cards.flavor: You strike with the weapon in your hands.
cards.rules: You attack with the weapon you are wielding. Weapon Attack takes the Melee or Ranged trait of that weapon, and its Range.

cards.name: Break Free
cards._note: v0.0.224 (Lucas, playtest 3): removing Immobilized costs 1 AP and is a Move Action (08-conditions.md, Immobilized). v0.0.431 (the book audit, Q9 and Q10): shown in Chapter 6; Prone allows it; a Grab can ask for a Check. 2026-11-20 (Lucas): always a Body or Instinct Check against the Immobilized DC; the same day the Immobilized DC became the Action DC (Chapter 1). 2026-11-21 (Lucas, playtest 7; the core rework B11): written in Tiers with a Check line; Doubles raise the Tier as on any roll; Self is its Distance, not a trait.
cards.flavor: You tear loose from whatever holds you.

versions.effects: You are no longer Immobilized, and no longer Grabbed if you were.

foundry.automationNote: the core rework B11: using it rolls the Body or Instinct Check (the higher) against the Action DC of what holds you (the highest on your Immobilized conditions; 13 with no Action behind it); a Tier 2 or 3 (Doubles count) ends Immobilized and Grabbed.
